documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter
Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Supreme Power Equipment Limited reported strong financial growth for the first half of fiscal year 2027, driven by healthy order book execution and robust end-market demand. Management highlighted that the ramp-up of the newly inaugurated Kannur facility is proceeding well, expanding manufacturing capabilities to support larger transformer opportunities. While inflationary pressures impacted raw material costs, the company leveraged price variation clauses and remained focused on procurement efficiencies. The current consolidated order book stands strong, providing solid revenue visibility for upcoming quarters. Supreme Power Equipment Limited reported Q1 FY27 total income of INR48.31 crores and an EBITDA margin of 18.4%, supported by strong order inflows and healthy execution momentum.

guidance.claim: Management expects full-year FY27 revenue to be between INR250 crores and INR300 crores.
guidance.quote: So cautiously, we are telling between INR250 crores to INR300 crores we can make this year.

guidance.claim: The company guides for a minimum 30% year-on-year rise in revenue.
guidance.quote: Year-on-year, 30% -- minimum 30% rise will be there on the revenue.

guidance.claim: PAT margin is expected to be maintained between 9% and 12% for FY27.
guidance.quote: So for FY27, we can expect between INR250 crores to INR300 crores top line. And the PAT margin will be around, we believe it will be around 9% to 12%.

guidance.claim: EBITDA margins are projected to be maintained between 18% and 20%.
guidance.quote: It will be maintained between 18% to 20%.

demand_outlook.claim: The strong growth reflects healthy execution of our order book and continued demand across our key markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The strong growth reflects healthy execution of our order book and continued demand across our key markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Overall, business momentum remains encouraging, and we continue to progress in line with our targets for the year.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, business momentum remains encouraging, and we continue to progress in line with our targets for the year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that demand for 220 kV transformers is very high and expects it to sustain for a minimum of 10 years.
demand_outlook.quote: For 220 kV transformers, number of players are less compared to all pan-India, number of players are less. But anyhow, demand is very high. Demand is very high. From the market information, at least minimum 10 years, this demand will sustain.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that demand is very good and the primary task is executing orders.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand is very good. Only thing is we need to execute the orders.

demand_outlook.claim: The company experienced sustained demand for its transformer solutions during the quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Q1 FY27 has been an encouraging start to the year, with our topline growing by over 37% year-on-year, underpinned by healthy execution momentum and sustained demand for our transformer solutions.

capex_expansion.claim: The ramp-up of our newly inaugurated Kannur facility is progressing well, with production and capacity utilisation scaling up as planned.
capex_expansion.quote: The ramp-up of our newly inaugurated Kannur facility is progressing well, with production and capacity utilisation scaling up as planned.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has planned tank manufacturing capacity with an estimated capex of INR20 crores to INR22 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, it's around INR20 crores, INR22 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Management expects the new tank manufacturing facility construction to be completed before March.
capex_expansion.quote: I think before March, I think this facility will complete.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial operations at the new Kannur facility commenced in February 2026.
The company expanded its manufacturing capacity to approximately 9,000 MVA.

margins_costs.claim: Margins witnessed some pressure during H1 FY27, primarily due to the inflationary environment and higher input costs, particularly across key raw materials.
margins_costs.quote: Margins witnessed some pressure during H1 FY27, primarily due to the inflationary environment and higher input costs, particularly across key raw materials.

margins_costs.claim: However, around 70–75% of our order book is covered by price variation clauses, which provides protection against significant movements in raw material prices and helps us manage cost volatility over the execution period.
margins_costs.quote: However, around 70–75% of our order book is covered by price variation clauses, which provides protection against significant movements in raw material prices and helps us manage cost volatility over the execution period.

margins_costs.claim: We remain focused on procurement efficiency, better product mix and operating leverage as volumes scale up.
margins_costs.quote: We remain focused on procurement efficiency, better product mix and operating leverage as volumes scale up.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material price rises are being absorbed and passed through due to price variation clauses included in the orders.
margins_costs.quote: And though there was a geopolitical issues were there due to that, the price rise of the raw materials are being absorbed because of this price variation clause, which we get from our buyers.

margins_costs.claim: Almost 80% to 85% of the orders held by the company are covered with a price variation clause.
margins_costs.quote: Almost 80%, 85% order which we are holding is covered with price variation clause.

margins_costs.claim: Margins witnessed some moderation during the quarter while profitability remained healthy.
margins_costs.quote: While margins witnessed some moderation during the quarter, profitability remained healthy and we continue to maintain a disciplined approach towards pricing, procurement and operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: Our order inflow remained healthy during the first half, and we secured 11 orders with a cumulative value of ₹209.24 Cr.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order inflow remained healthy during the first half. We secured 11 orders with a cumulative value of ₹209.24 Cr, with execution timelines ranging from 7 to 17 months.

orders_capacity.claim: Our current order book stands at ₹565.80 Cr, providing healthy revenue visibility for the coming quarters.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current order book stands at ₹565.80 Cr, providing healthy revenue visibility for the coming quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: The additional capacity is expected to support execution of our growing order book and enable us to participate in larger and higher-capacity transformer opportunities.
orders_capacity.quote: The additional capacity is expected to support execution of our growing order book and enable us to participate in larger and higher-capacity transformer opportunities.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's order book stood at INR590.06 crores as of August 13, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book stands at INR590.06 crores as of August 13, 2026, providing healthy execution visibility over the coming quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: Government orders represent approximately 30.10% of the total order book and non-government orders represent 69.9%.
orders_capacity.quote: In terms of customer mix, government orders stand at INR177.6 crores, representing approximately 30.10% of the total order book, while nongovernment orders stands at INR412.46 crores, represent approximately 69.9%.

orders_capacity.claim: Power transformers constitute 76.91% of the order book.
orders_capacity.quote: From the product perspective, power transformers constitute the largest share on the order book at INR453.83 crores, representing approximately 76.91%.

orders_capacity.claim: Distribution transformers represent 17.84% and inverter duty transformers represent 5.25% of the order book.
orders_capacity.quote: This is followed by distribution transformers at INR105.27 crores, representing 17.84% and inverter duty transformer at INR30.96 crores, representing 5.25%.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the new Kannur plant is currently running at 20% to 25%.
orders_capacity.quote: The new plant, our capacity is almost 20% to 25% utilization as of now. We are utilizing 20% to 25%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured 10 orders aggregating ₹195.64 Cr during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: We are particularly pleased with the strength of our order inflows during the quarter, having secured 10 orders aggregating ₹195.64 Cr.

orders_capacity.claim: The current consolidated order book stands at approximately ₹590.06 Cr.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current consolidated order book stands at approximately ₹590.06 Cr, providing healthy revenue visibility over the coming quarters.

capital_allocation.claim: The company plans to raise term loans from banks for the upcoming tank manufacturing capex.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes, we will be raising term loans for that.

capital_allocation.claim: Management states there is no equity dilution requirement for the current financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: So for this year, there is no requirement for equity dilution.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to migrate to the main board in the next year.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, yes. Next year, definitely, we will.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects statutory approvals for the new tank manufacturing facility to be obtained before the end of next month.
management_commitments.quote: I think we will get the approval before end of next month.

management_commitments.claim: The new tank manufacturing facility is targeted for completion before March.
management_commitments.quote: I think before March, I think this facility will complete.

management_commitments.claim: The immediate priority is the timely execution of the order book while progressively ramping up utilisation at the new manufacturing facility.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, our immediate priority is the timely execution of this order book while progressively ramping up utilisation at our new manufacturing facility.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
